The '''''Assiduous''''' was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] used by [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Valin Draco]].

==History==
The ''Assiduous'' traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] to pick up the proclaimed traitor [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]], [[Gilder Varth]]. It later traveled to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] to deliver a shipment of slaves to [[Darga Jiramma Mionne|Darga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. When the deal went wrong, it returned to the planet with the intent of covering up the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] dealings with Darga, and was embroiled in the brief [[Battle of Bespin (Imperial Period)|battle]] above the planet. Despite launching [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], it was unable to stop the ships associated with the secret [[Alderaanian Resistance]]. Draco contacted the rebels, saying he would hunt them down for their actions there.
